how the communication skills and behaviors of physicians can be enhanced to improve patient care and patient satisfaction.
how physicians and other members of the health care team communicate with patients, families, and other health professionals.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
patient-centered communication is a crucial part of the patient-physician interaction.
patient-centered care is a model of care delivery that emphasizes the patient and their family in all aspects of care delivery.
relationship centered care is a model of health care that is focused on the patient and family, and the physician-patient and family relationship.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have been able to show that relationship-centered communication skills are associated with higher patient satisfaction scores, and this relationship is independent of other communication skills.
we have been successful at developing and implementing a model of relationship-centered care that has the potential to improve the health of our patients.
we are committed to the following principles: Patient-Centered Care.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the patient-centered care approach is not just an option for health care providers.
the relationship between patient and physician has to be a partnership, not a dictatorship.
relationship-centered care is not just an idealistic goal.
